title: Seedling

stage.name: Seedling
stage.description: True leaves begin making food from sunlight, water and air.

questions.prompt: What do leaves use to make food?
questions.why: Photosynthesis turns light, water and carbon dioxide into sugar.

questions.prompt: Which gas do plants release while making food?
questions.why: Oxygen is released as a by-product of making sugar.

questions.prompt: Match each part of the plant to its job.
questions.why: Roots drink, the stem carries, and leaves make sugar from light.

questions.prompt: What keeps a relationship nourished from day to day?
options: Noticing and answering each other's small bids for attention
questions.why: A “bid” can be as small as “look at this.” Researchers who study couples find that turning toward these small moments builds lasting connection.

talk: What's a small way the other could turn toward you this week?
